## Checklist

- [ ] Ownership is unambiguous.
- [ ] Required ADRs are accepted or this PR contains only the proposal.
- [ ] Cross-repository owners have acknowledged affected contracts.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when appropriate.
- [ ] `./scripts/check-workspace` passes.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, model weights, raw runs, or sibling repositories are tracked.
